units: <cite ref="Mishnah Bekhorot 6:9">Bekh. VI, 9</cite> <he>זְנַב הגדי</he> the tail of a kid; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Yoma 41b">Yoma 41ᵇ</cite> <he>זְ׳ לשון</he> the tail-end (fringes) of the band.
<cite ref="Eruvin 18a:26">Erub. 18ᵃ</cite> (ref. to <he>צלע</he>, <cite ref="Genesis 2:22">Gen. II, 22</cite>) <he>ז׳</he> it means the tail (with which Adam was originally created).
<cite ref="Mishnah Kilayim 4:6">Kil. IV, 6</cite> <he>ואחת יוצאה ז׳</he> and one vine projects like a tail.
Ukts. I, 3 ז׳ של אשכול the skeleton of the cluster of grapes (the thin branches), opp. to יד, the stem; a. fr.—Trnsf. the last, least.

Ab. IV, 15, v. אֲרִי.—Euphem. membrum virile. Tanḥ. Ki Thetsé 10 (expl. ויזנב, Deut. XXV, 18) הכה אותן מכת ז׳ Amalek mutilated them by cutting off &c.; Pesik. Zakh., p. 27ᵃ; Pesik. R. s. 12; Num. R. s. 13; v. זְמוֹרָה.—Denom.
